desc:
New for full production in 2025, the XLV is a similar take on our limited edition "Living Legend" handgun, but without the special engraving.
The XLV is available in your choice of .45 ACP, or in 45/410, and features our new flat-sided, double barrel which is perfect for your own custom engraving*.
With the additional weight in the barrel, the XLV is a very smooth shooter that you'll enjoy for years!
